name: Effective Range / Minimum Teaching Set Size
details: Full active-coordinate samples identify every concept.
proof: Two distinct concepts differ at an active coordinate. Thus the labels of any concept on the full effective range identify it within the class, giving it a teaching set of size at most \(\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\). In particular the minimum teaching-set size is at most that value.
witness_verification: For #classes/singletons with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs.
